comments.value: 4,5 years later this still isn't a thing? This doesn't sound like a hard addition, and for some people with a medication schedule (like myself) it'd be a huge help.

Could be good to have a clock but I'd prefer the option to have it in the vrchat menu 
as to not distract the view in the HUD.
@{616a76658ee568148ed94f24|full_name}: Agreed, quick menu would be a good spot. Maybe a setting to turn it on/off.

Euh.... it's not like VRC devs must solve it for everyone. Because there are so many alternatives, it's not very important and big problem.

Let me sum up alternatives to read clock

++ Program solutions

- Steam VR overlay (clock is below)

- OVR Toolkit / XSOverlay / DailyOVR put clock on your waist

Heck, some overlay tools are free and you don't want use it? I can say it's useful tool for everyone even not as streamer.

++ Ingame world solutions

- Rooms with clock on wall. You see it often around, unless you're super lazy to look even a bit.

- Waist clock feature is even possible, as part of world menu system.

- Can even make HUD with clock (it exists in some worlds!)

What can Quest / Pico users do here? Overlay is not possible, but they have own OS overlay with Quest/Pico button. In worlds they can look at wall clocks.

I can understand why it has so low priority to add clock below the menu due many alternatives. And you really don't want even install free overlay tool? You are really very lazy. Some of you have installed mods and don't even want install overlay tool? I don't get it.

Add clock in HUD is even less requested and will for sure not added. Waist clock is better (and ofc below menu)

This clock-in-hud is possible with some overlay tools.

In short, it's actually not a big problem because many of us have already found own solution with overlay tool or own clock in your home world. 

Even more the post HERE is since Feb 2018 posted. There are not a lot solutions in 2018, so i can understand it. But now, 2023, we have plenty solutions for it, so why still bother to ask today? Let devs decide when they have time for it.

Oh indeed, clock is also LoT, like chat box. So i am kinda surprised it's not added today below the menu because it's simple feature.
if you're doing PCVR you can just do that with a SteamVR addon instead or if you're just on quest you can quickly goto the quest menu to see the time...
